patch.value: This is the same failure class already recorded against release.yml, where an unanchored version regex restamped a nested help string every release and the corrupted output never appeared in a diff.
sync-version could silently restamp the wrong version literal during a release

syncExtensionVersion replaced the first match of an unanchored version regex in src/extension.ts. Only one such literal exists today, so nothing is currently corrupted, but the moment any earlier version: string appears - a flag description, a help example - the release job would stamp that string instead. Because the damage is written by the release job rather than by a reviewed diff, it would survive every review. The match is now required to be unique, turning a silent mis-stamp into a loud failure.

A file with two version: literals aborts the sync with a message naming both and leaves the file unmodified; a file with none still reports the missing literal; the single-literal case stamps exactly as before
